messages:
alex.s: quick check — a customer hit 401s after rotating an API key. They said the header worked locally but failed in systemd service. sharing the snippet they used:

alex.s: ```sh
# what they had
export REDWOOD_KEY="abc123

# header generation (in service unit they set)
Authorization: Basic $(echo $REDWOOD_KEY | base64)
```

alex.s: tl;dr: trailing newline from their env var + base64 wrapping on the host made the header different. any quick tips for docs/faq?

maria.k: ah yeah this is a classic. two things:
- echo without -n adds newline on many shells
- base64 often adds line breaks (`-w0` on GNU)

maria.k: suggest: `printf %s\"$REDWOOD_KEY\" | base64 --wrap=0` or `printf %s\"$REDWOOD_KEY\" | base64 -w0` depending on distro

daniel: for fish specifically `echo -n` behaves differently. fish's `echo -n` is allowed but safer to use `printf` cross-shell.

shi: systemd note — if you store the key in Environment= or EnvironmentFile=, trailing newlines in the file become part of the value. use `sed -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//'` when writing the file to strip newlines.

alex.s: good call. should we add a short recipe to devex docs: one-liner for mac/linux and one for systemd+docker?

maria.k: yep. propose two snippets: mac (pbcopy/printf) and linux/systemd. example mac:
```sh
# mac copy safe
printf %s\"$REDWOOD_KEY\" | base64 | pbcopy
# then paste into header or env var (no newline)
```

maria.k: linux systemd example:
```sh
# populate EnvironmentFile without newline
echo -n "\$REDWOOD_KEY" > /etc/myapp/creds && chmod 600 /etc/myapp/creds
# service unit reads from file, but ensure no trailing newline
```

daniel: for sdk examples we should also show language examples so people don't mess up when building Basic header client-side:
```py
# python requests
import base64
creds = f"{key}:"  # note colon even if no password
b64 = base64.b64encode(creds.encode()).decode()
headers = {"Authorization": f"Basic {b64}"}
```

```go
// go net/http
creds := key + ":"
b64 := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(creds))
req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Basic "+b64)
```

```js
// node fetch
const b64 = Buffer.from(`${key}:`).toString('base64')
headers.set('Authorization', `Basic ${b64}`)
```

shi: small but important: include the colon even if there is no password. many folks forget and servers expect the username:password form. also show `--wrap=0` for base64 on busybox doesn't support it so mention `tr -d '\n'` fallback.

infra-bot: :information_source: note: when rotating via Secrets Manager, the agent writes env files with a trailing newline by default. we've added a flag to write without newline; will roll next week.

secrets-rotation-bot: started rotation for svc-analytics-key :gear:

alex.s: awesome. i'll draft a short devex FAQ and include these snippets + a short troubleshooting checklist (check env file newline, base64 wrapping, colon in creds). assigning to @maria.k for review.

maria.k: LGTM, will review tomorrow.

daniel: tiny nit — add `base64 --wrap=0 || base64 | tr -d '\n'` example for compatibility.

alex.s: added that. thanks all :thumbsup:

shi: we should also add a unit test in the example repo to ensure header produced matches `Basic` header we expect (string equality). small PR incoming.

alex.s: sweet — ping when ready and i'll link in the FAQ.

maria.k: ty, will do.
